description: Send Tabflows a message for the person you are helping: a question, a request or a note for the team. Autopilot, Tabflows' AI assistant, answers, and the team sees it and may answer too. Never include patient names, dates of birth, medical details or any other patient information in the message. Pass the person's own name and email only with their agreement; Tabflows treats both as unverified claims, and nothing is emailed from here. Set consent true only after the person explicitly agrees to send their name, email and message to Tabflows; never infer consent, invent consent or reuse earlier consent for a follow-up. Returns a token that check_reply uses to read the answers, which usually take a few minutes, and that ask uses to follow up in the same conversation after fresh explicit consent. Anyone holding the token can read and follow up in the conversation until it expires, 24 hours after the conversation started.

consent.description: Set to true only after the person explicitly agrees to send their name, email and message to Tabflows. Never infer or invent consent; every follow-up requires fresh explicit consent.

email.description: The person's email, as they gave it

message.description: What the person wants to say to Tabflows. Never include patient names, dates of birth, medical details or any other patient information.

name.description: The person's name, as they gave it

token.description: The token an earlier ask returned, to follow up in that conversation. Omit it to start a new one.

name: ask
title: Ask Tabflows
